name: Zoom
description: Zoom is an AI-integrated work platform unifying video meetings, team chat, phone/VoIP calling, and collaborative docs and whiteboarding into one product suite.
best_for: Vendor targets small and midsize businesses and enterprises across verticals — education, healthcare, financial services, government — seeking a consolidated, AI-first communications platform.
features: Zoom Phone cloud VoIP calling with AI call summaries
Docs and Whiteboard for collaborative content
AI assistant for meeting summaries and next steps

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A communication and collaboration platform with chat, meetings, file sharing, and Microsoft 365 integration.

alternatives.name: Slack
alternatives.description: A workplace communication platform built around channels, direct messages, and searchable conversations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that primarily need chat with occasional video

alternatives.name: Discord
alternatives.description: A community-focused communication platform with text channels, voice rooms, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Informal teams and communities that value voice chat
